safe_islands.description: Changes confined to HTTP 429 implementation/lab surfaces and proven to be covered by actual source-proximate HTTP 429 pull-request workflow triggers.

fallback.reason: Any path outside a single known safe island, or any reduced-route path lacking actual source-gate trigger coverage, requires the full public-analysis matrix during the observation phase.

coverage_rule: For a reduced route, every changed path must match pull_request.paths in at least one current .github/workflows/validate-http-429*.yml workflow. The router reads those triggers from the repository at evaluation time. Any uncovered path fails closed to FULL.
promotion_rule: This policy remains diagnostic only. Real job skipping requires a separate reversible promotion after trigger-coverage regressions and paired live observations remain green under the still-authoritative full public-analysis matrix.
